title: Effect
wikitext:
[[Image:Active_and_temporary_effects.png|500px|thumb|upright|Various effects.]]
'''Active and temporary effects''' can be placed on [[character]]s. strengthening or weakening the character considerably. They are shown on the top left corner with a short description when hovered over.

==Types of effects==
Effects can both be negative or positive depending on if it was an enemy, the character or an ally that inflicted it. They're often inflicted by [[aura]]s, [[curse]]s, when within [[ground effects]] or when the character is [[hit]] by special [[skill]]s. Many of them are active for a short [[duration]], some of them can also stack leading to even stronger effects. 

===Buffs===
[[Image:buffs.png|540px]]

[[Buff]]s have a green border and are shown in one row at the upper left corner. These can originate from skill gems, passive skills and unique items.

[[Minion]]s and [[totem]]s also generate icons. They always precede the temporary effects and are separated by a bar.

===Debuffs===
[[Image:screenshot-0140.png|45px|[[Bleed]] debuff]]

[[Debuff]]s have a red border and are shown in separate row below [[Buffs]] / positive effects. These can originate from skill gems, passive skills and unique items.

===Flask Effects===
[[File:screenshot-0132.png|135px]]
[[File:screenshot-0136.png|41px]]
{{for|more information|Flask}}

All the utility [[flask]]s and all the [[Flask#Modifiers|affixes]] on them can create gold bordered temporary effects. Futhermore certain uniques like [[Doryani's Invitation]] grant additional temporary effects while other flasks effects are active. Some unique flasks also grant additional effects like {{il|Divination Distillate}}. Flask effects overwrite each other the only exception is which shows the implicit mod of an {{il|Quicksilver Flask}} with a [[Flask#Modifiers|of Adrenaline]] suffix, both count as different effects.

===Charges===
[[File:screenshot-0135.png|90px]]

The first number show the duration left, after which the [[charge]]s expire. The number below is the quantity of those charges.

===Skills===
[[File:screenshot-0143.png|90px]]

Certain skills display a icon indicating the current state of some mechanic. The first shows {{il|Reave}} and the second a [[shrine]], which is considered a skill as well. They have the same border colour as charges. There's been no need to distinguish the two thus far.<ref name="FlaskNotBuff" />

===Minions & Totems===
[[File:screenshot-0138.png|300px]]

Shows a list of minions. The number indicates the number of minions of those kind, if there is only one a red life bar is shown instead. For more information, see the [[Minion]] and [[Totem]] articles.
